spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Kephalaia:
 The
 Three
 Entre
aties


---


**
¶6.
** This
 turning
 of the interior
 faculties toward the Divine Love has
 existed
 from
 the very
 beginning:
 the
 divine
 qualities
 within
 the celest
ial mind
 first
 opened
 themselves
 in
 reception toward
 the
 In
most Divine from
 which
 they proceed
. And
 what
 they
 sought
 to receive was
 given
 to them,
 for
 every
 faculty
 that
 opens
 itself
 toward
 the Divine is
 filled
 according
 to its capacity
.


**¶8.** The
 proce
eding Divine sphere
 —
 the living
 maternal
 principle through
 which all
 spiritual life
 is
 sustained
 — this
 sphere
 turned
 itself
 entirely
 toward the
 Inmost Divine, the source of all
 love
 and the
 origin
 of all order
,
 which
 is the Father
. It
 opened
 itself to
 receive
 a
 new
 influx of power
.
 And
 a
 great gift was granted
:
 not
 to
 this
 sust
aining sphere
 alone
, but to every
 subordin
ate faculty
 of
 good
 and truth that
 acts
 within
 it
.

**¶9.**
 This
 entre
aty was
 made
 on
 behalf of the celest
ial will
 itself
 —
 the most interior good of innocence —
 because
 of how it
 had gone
 forth from
 the in
most degree
 and
 cast
 itself down
ward into the natural.
 It had
 become remote
 from the sustaining sphere of divine truth
. It had separated from its
 living
 source
 and
 given itself freely
 into
 the
 
angu
ish of spiritual
 combat
. It entered
 into tem
ptation in the natural mind against all
 that
 destro
ys,
 gri
eves, and weakens —
 into
 the states of 
utter fals
ity,
 into
 the deepest hells of despair
 and
 d
read
, into the very
 pit
 where
 inf
ernal fals
ities dwell,
 among
 the dominant
 powers of evil itself
.

**¶10.**
 Indeed
, this
 celest
ial good
 is
 like a governing
 principle
 standing
 surrounded
 on
 every
 side by assaulting evils and
 falsities. And
 when
 the sust
aining Divine
 sphere
 turned
 wholly
 toward the Inmost Divine Love
, the origin
 and
 source of all order
, it sought
 that
 a
 new power
 be
 sent
 forth
 —
 a protecting
,
 red
eeming, and sust
aining operation
 of
 truth —
 for
 the sake
 of the good of
 innoc
ence that
 is
 held
 fast
 in 
anguish.

**¶11
.** And
 as
 the
 Divine
 sphere
 had opened
 itself in
 reception,
 so its
 prayer was fulfilled: the
 Inmost Divine turned
 and
 gave what
 was sought
 —
 the great
 power of
 Divine
 Truth proce
eding with the
 ability
 to restore peace. The
 sust
aining sphere
 and
 the proce
eding power
 of
 truth came
 together with great force
 to the very
 boundary
 between the spiritual and the natural.
 And
 they
 elevated
 the celestial will out of that
 combat
 and tem
ptation in
 which
 it was held
.

**¶12.**
 The
 celest
ial good had
 given
 itself freely, as
 a
 grace, for
 the sake of the sust
aining Divine
 sphere
. Yet
 through
 this descent
 it
 had become estranged and
 far from its
 source
 —
 the
 one
 whom
 the
 ass
aulting evils and falsities had
 placed
 into
 profound
 affl
iction,
 the
 one imm
ersed in the state
 of fals
ity,
 having
 become as
 though
 weak
ened.


**¶13.** The
 proce
eding power
 of Divine
 Truth laid
 hold of the celest
ial good and drew
 it in
ward.
 It freed it from bond
age.
 It restored
 it to order and
 brought
 it into heavenly peace,
 into
 the state
 of rest
.
 This
 first
 restoration
 of
 peace
 was accomplished
 according
 to the unified
 will
 of the three in
most operations
 of
 the Divine
.

**¶14.**
 A
 great
 power
 went
 forth on
 behalf of the beloved
 celest
ial good — the
 interior
 will
 that
 had become
 remote and
 distant
,
 on
 whose
 behalf the sust
aining sphere had interc
eded,
 the
 one held
 fast in the 
anguish of tem
ptation. The
 proce
eding Divine Truth entered
 into the very
 place
 of destruction
 and deb
il
itation
, and it
 freed
 and
 redeemed the celest
ial good,
 giving
 it peace from
 its affl
iction.
 It restored
 it to order
,
 to
 rest
, and
 to joy
.
 And
 the
 proce
eding power
 of truth itself
 has
 become one
 with that
 good
, at
 rest
 together
 with it,
 forever
.

**¶17.**
 And
 they
 constructed
 the entire
 ordered
 form
 of the regenerating
 mind,
 and
 completed
 it
 with its
 interior
 degrees
 of distinction
,
 with
 its cycles
 of spiritual
 progression, with the
 vessels
 of wisdom
 that move
 through the higher understanding, with the bonds
 of good that hold all
 things in connection
,
 with the planes
 of the natural
 mind as foundation, with the protecting
 boundaries
 of truth
, and
 with every
 containing
 form of the understanding that receives good and
 truth.
 They
 completed
 this
 entire
 spiritual
 structure and set it in
 order according to the celest
ial principles
 of Divine
 Love
.

**¶18.**
 Then
 the proce
eding Divine sphere
 stood
 together
 with the love
 of wisdom
, and the great
 form
ative power stood
 with
 the proceeding power
 of truth and
 with
 the celest
ial will
. These five
 operations
 stood unified
,
 turning
 toward the Inmost Divine, the
 origin
 of all order
.
 They sought that
 a governing
 and
 gu
iding principle be given
 — one
 that would lead
 all
 the ordered
 forms and
 structures
 that
 had
 been constructed,
 and
 that would come
 to pur
ify all
 the good and truth still
 held captive in affl
iction within
 the natural.


**¶19.** They
 opened
 themselves
 in
 reception toward the Inmost Divine,
 and their prayer was received
.
 What
 they sought was
 given.
 The Divine
 summ
oned from
 within
 itself
 the
 Medi
ating Presence —
 the third
 great
 operation
 of Divine
 Truth
 reaching
 into the outermost natural. This
 Presence came
 forth
 from
 the power
 of the
 Divine
 itself.
 It perceived
 the whole
 of
 the capt
ive good and truth —
 how
 it
 was ent
angled as
 though
 in chains
, held
 fast
 in bond
age.
 It beh
eld the ordered
 spiritual structures that the
 prior
 operations had constructed,
 all
 that had come
 down
 from the higher
 degrees. And
 again
 it
 perceived
 the living
 good
 and
 truth —
 that
 it was entangled and
 fixed
 in a
 great
 tor
ment, opp
ressed in the f
oul
ness
 of the corpor
eal abyss that
 had
 joined
 itself
 to it.

**¶20
.** Therefore
, out
 of the Divine
's own love
, the Mediating Presence revealed
 its
 pathway
 even
 before
 the lowest
 and
 most sun
ken
 states of the natural and
 corporeal mind
,
 in
 order
 to
 free
 the capt
ive good and truth.
 It re
deemed it
 from every
 form
 of corpor
eal falsity — every
 dead
 appearance
 of the s
enses —
 in
 which
 it
 suffered
.
 It gave
 it peace.
 It restored
 it to order
 in
 the state
 of rest and b
lessedness.

**¶21
.** And this
 Mediating Presence also fulfilled
 the unified
 purpose
 of the three prior
 degrees
 of Divine operation —
 the purpose
 of those
 who had opened
 themselves to
 the Inmost Divine on
 its
 behalf. It accomplished
 the very
 thing
 they
 had sought,
 together
 with the will
 of the
 Inmost Divine itself
, which
 had
 granted
 what
 was entre
ated.

**¶22.
** The third
 operation
 is
 the actual
 trans
ference of the living good
 and truth that
 had been freed:
 the elevation
 of it
 from bond
age in
 the natural,
 the
 release
 of it into
 peace
 from
 affl
iction.
 And
 this
 operation
 became
 the governing principle —
 the first
 and
 sovereign
 power
 — over
 the
 entire external mind.

**¶
25.** *
[
The
 text
 here
 is fragmentary,
 but the spiritual
 sense
 that
 can
 be disc
erned is this
:]
* At
 the third
 turning
 toward
 the Divine
, truth
 was
 both
 revealed and veiled according
 to the
 capacity
 of reception
. The Divine image
 was displayed
, then
 hidden
 from
 those
 states
 unable
 to bear it. The external
 tru
ths —
 the garments —
 were given
.
 Liberation
 occurred
. The voice
 of Divine
 Truth
 was heard. The external
 natural —
 the body — was addressed
. Prayer
 opened
 the way.
 The sust
aining sphere
 interc
eded again
,
 that
 freedom
 might be given through
 the
 Mediating Presence.

**
¶26.** *[
Fragment
ary:]
* Together
 with the living
 fac
ulties of good
 and truth, forever
.
 From
 the in
most,
 the perception
 of future
 heavenly states —
 hope
 — was given
.

**¶27.**
 Divine
 Truth in
 its fullness —
 the lumin
ous wisdom
 that
 is the Divine Human itself
 — perf
ected the purpose
 of all
 prior
 operations. The
 fac
ulties of
 the mind
 perceived
 wisdom
. The Divine
 gave
 to
 them
 the very
 power that is the full
ness of Divine Truth. It
 granted
 the
 will of
 the fundamental
 substances
 of
 the mind.
 This
 first operation
 descended
 —
 it
 hum
bled itself
 — and thereby
 became
 free
. Its
 nature
 was made
 manifest even
 to the opposing
 fals
ities and evils. The
 perception
 of heavenly life
 was received
. The lumin
ous power
 of Divine Truth and
 the entre
aty of the celest
ial principles
 of good
 were
 fulfilled
.

**¶31.**
 All
 the good and truth that remains
 ent
angled and
 bound throughout every degree of the mind —
 it
 shall
 be set
 free,
 and cleansed of
 fals
ity, and purified of
 evil,
 and redeemed from
 bond
age.


**¶37.** The
 Divine
 re
deemed the living interior
 human that
 was
 entangled throughout
 the whole
 natural
 mind
.
 It accomplished
 the restoration
 of good
 and truth to
 the
 Inmost Divine,
 the first
 source
.
 It made
 redemption for every
 captive aff
ection of
 good
,
 for
 every bound
 perception
 of truth that
 it
 had freed
. The
 Divine
 Wisdom
 has mercy
. Peace
 shall be
 given. The living
 good
 and truth shall
 be freed from 
anguish and
 shall come
 forth into the eternal
.


**¶43.** Indeed
, the good
 and truth that was freed in one degree
 of
 the
 mind,
 through the operation
 of
 good
 and truth already
 lib
erated in another degree —
 that
 lib
erated
 good
,
 too
, shall
 be fully
 redeemed in the name and
 quality
 of the operation
 that freed
 it. It is
 redeemed and
 pur
ified and restored
 to
 its original celestial essence
. Moreover
, it becomes
 itself
 a cooper
ating instrument of the Divine, and it
 interc
edes for the
 good and truth newly
 released
 from the corporeal and
 external
 natural.
 It pet
itions that
 love
 be con
joined to
 it
, and that ev
ils be removed from it,
 through
 the power of
 the
 celest
ial principles
 of the
 Divine.

**¶44.
** Just
 as peace
 came
 about for the capt
ive good and truth through the operation of
 the
 good and truth already
 freed,
 so in
 turn
 shall
 that
 liber
ating good
 and truth itself
 find
 its own
 peace and
 be
 released
 from the external
 natural. It passes
 into the kingdom
 of wisdom
.
 And
 the
 good
 and truth that was
 re
deemed through
 its
 agency
 finds
 its own fulf
illment;
 and
 together
 they
 enter
 into the heav
enly state
 of eternal
 love
 and
 peace.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: For this entreaty has been since the beginning [, when] the gods first made entreaty of their Father. They were granted their entreaty and their request.

The Great Spirit, the Mother of Life, she claimed and prayed and besought and glorified and praised the first established one, who is the Father. She besought him an entreaty. She claimed of him a request. She received a great gift; she and the many powers with her.

She besought an entreaty on behalf of the First Man, because of how he had come forth and thrown himself down. He became distant from the Mother of Life. He separated from her and gave himself; in great affliction. He joined war on earth with the destruction and the grief and the weakness; in the worlds of Darkness; in the abysses made of fear; in the midst of the demons' ditch; amongst the powers of the Devil!

Indeed, he is like a king standing in the midst of his enemies. And when the Mother of Life petitioned and prayed and glorified and praised the Father, the first established one, she did petition him that he might send a power; a protector and redeemer and helper for the son of God who is set in affliction.

Now, just as she had besought and interceded, so likewise was her prayer fulfilled and received into the presence of the Father of Greatness. He turned and gave to her her entreaty: the great power, the Living Spirit, the giver of ease. The Mother of Life and the Living Spirit came with great power to the borders of the territory. They brought the First Man up from that war and struggle, wherein he is set.

He gave himself as a grace for the Mother of Life. He became estranged and far from her, the one whom his enemies (place) in great affliction, the one who is in the land of Darkness since he became weak.

The Living Spirit grasped and took him in. He freed him. He set him right and gave him ease in the land of rest [and joy. This is] the Living Spirit, the first giver of ease [, who fulfilled] the will of these three. The welcomer [shall] find with the welcomer that [which was sought.]

[There went forth] a great power [on behalf] of the loved one [, that is,] the First Man who had been far away. He had become distant. She had besought on his behalf. He was set fast in affliction. (The Living Spirit) went to the place of destruction and weakness, the one that freed and redeemed him and gave him ease from the affliction. He set him right with rest and joy. He has himself become rested, with him for ever.

[Then the powers came forth,] and they built the universe and completed it with its firmaments, with its wheels, with the ships of light that are in the heights, with its fastenings, with its earths and its walls, with its vessels. They completed the universe and set it right by the fathers of light.

Then, the Great Spirit stood with the Beloved of the Lights, the Great Builder with the Living Spirit and the First Man. These five stood to prayer; they glorified and praised the Father, the first established one. They besought of him an entreaty. They claimed of him a request, that he might give them the power [, that is,] the leader, a guide to all the things of activity that they had constructed. That he might come and purify the living soul that is set in affliction.

They prayed and besought their Father, and he received from them their prayer [. And] he gave them their entreaty and their request [. And] he summoned from him [a great power,] which is the Third Ambassador. He, he came from the power of his greatness. He saw the entire soul, how it is entangled in a chain and set fast. It sees the things of activity that his brothers have constructed, that have come from the heights. Again, he saw the living soul, that it is entangled and set fast in a great torture. It is oppressed in the stink of the abyss that is joined with it.

And therefore, he, the Ambassador [, came forth] in his charity. So, he revealed his way, before this underworld that is dug deep down, to free the living soul. He redeemed it from all the fleshes of death wherein it is pained. He gave it ease. He set it right in the place of rest and joy.

And again, he too, the Ambassador, he fulfilled the will of these three; the will of his brothers who had besought the Father for him. They claimed of him a request, together with the [will] of the Father, the one that [received their prayer. And] he gave the entreaty that they had besought of him.
The third is the transferral of the living soul that he had freed. He released it and gave it ease from the affliction. He became king and first to the entire body.

Again, let us come to the third entreaty when they besought him the third time [. And the Ambassador] displayed his image [to the rulers. And then] he hid his image from the [powers of Darkness. And] he stood firm [. And] they revealed [unto them] the light [. And] the First Man [did] mock [his enemies. They called] to him in [praise,] which is exalted [. And a] garment [of light was given. And] they were freed [. They called] to him [and he heard] their voice [. And] the body [received the] prayer [. And] it [did] beseech [the Father. And] the body [did] beseech [the Father. And] she besought [the Father that they might] in [all things] be free [through the] Ambassador [of light,] and also [the powers with him.]

[He shall abide] with the living ones and [be joined with them] for ever [. And] the first [established one sent forth] from the [greatness of his power. And] he gave him the hope [of the land of light.]
The first: [is the entreaty on behalf] of the living soul that is entangled and bound in the entire universe. For it shall be freed and cleansed and purified and redeemed
It is redeemed and purified and attains its first essence.

this is how this soul shall find ease and escape that body. It goes into the land of light [. And the] soul that was redeemed because of it [, rest] comes about for it; and it goes to the land of life and rest [for ever.]

Also, Jesus the Splendour perfected the will [...] the will [...] they found the light [...] the will of the [...] that he had [...] he gave them the power that is Jesus the Splendour. He granted the will of the elements. [...] for ever. This first [...] he was humbled, he was made free [...] the [...]-ness is displayed to his enemies.
